#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Hand-computed scenario checks for the trickiest contract corners."""
import json, subprocess, sys

PROG = ["python3", "/app/submission/main.py"]
fails = 0


def run(doc):
    p = subprocess.run(PROG, input=json.dumps(doc).encode(),
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.returncode
    return json.loads(p.stdout)


def model(C=2, E=1, K=1, F=1, le=None, ge=None, cw=None, cb=None, cs=None,
          dw=None, db=None):
    return dict(
        classes=C, embedding_dim=E,
        length_embedding=le if le is not None else [[i] for i in range(16)],
        gap_embedding=ge if ge is not None else [[0] for _ in range(16)],
        kernel=K,
        conv_weights=cw if cw is not None else [[[1, 0]]],
        conv_bias=cb if cb is not None else [0],
        conv_shift=cs if cs is not None else [0],
        dense_weights=dw if dw is not None else [[0], [1]],
        dense_bias=db if db is not None else [1, 0],
    )


def config(**kw):
    cfg = dict(
        slots=1, window=1, idle_timeout=1000, len_quantum=1, gap_quantum=1,
        rate_num=1, rate_den=1, bucket_capacity=10, initial_tokens=10,
        pending_capacity=10, lanes=1, service=[1], fallback=0,
        time_edges=[0], count_edges=[0], probability=[[65536]],
    )
    cfg.update(kw)
    return cfg


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    global fails
    if not cond:
        print("FAIL:", name, detail)
        fails += 1


def pkt(t, c, length=0, draw=0):
    return dict(time=t, connection=c, length=length, draw=draw)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scenario 1
# exact idle-timeout boundary triggers a reset
doc = dict(
    version=1, config=config(idle_timeout=10), model=model(),
    connections=[dict(id="c1", slot=0, label=0, split="dev")],
    packets=[pkt(0, "c1", 5), pkt(10, "c1", 6)],
)
r = run(doc)
check("s1 packets", len(r["packets"]) == 2)
check("s1 gen0", r["packets"][0]["generation"] == 1, r["packets"][0])
check("s1 gen1", r["packets"][1]["generation"] == 2, r["packets"][1])
check("s1 forward0", r["packets"][0]["forward"] == 0)
check("s1 forward1", r["packets"][1]["forward"] == 0, r["packets"][1])
check("s1 credit0", r["packets"][0]["credit"] == 9, r["packets"][0])
check("s1 credit1", r["packets"][1]["credit"] == 9, r["packets"][1])
check("s1 jobs", [j["id"] for j in r["jobs"]] == [0, 1])
check("s1 logits0", r["jobs"][0]["logits"] == [1, 5], r["jobs"][0])
check("s1 done0", r["jobs"][0]["done"] == 1, r["jobs"][0])
check("s1 start1", r["jobs"][1]["start"] == 10, r["jobs"][1])
check("s1 done1", r["jobs"][1]["done"] == 11, r["jobs"][1])
check("s1 status0", r["jobs"][0]["status"] == "applied", r["jobs"][0])
check("s1 status1", r["jobs"][1]["status"] == "applied", r["jobs"][1])
check("s1 votes", r["connections"][0]["votes"] == [1, 1], r["connections"][0])
check("s1 connpred", r["connections"][0]["prediction"] == 0, r["connections"][0])
check("s1 dev macro", r["reports"]["dev"]["macro_f1"] == [1, 2], r["reports"]["dev"])
check("s1 eval macro", r["reports"]["eval"]["macro_f1"] == [0, 1], r["reports"]["eval"])
check("s1 eval conns", r["reports"]["eval"]["connections"] == 0)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scenario 2
# out-of-order completion -> superseded
doc = dict(
    version=1, config=config(lanes=2, service=[1, 5]), model=model(),
    connections=[dict(id="c1", slot=0, label=0, split="dev")],
    packets=[pkt(0, "c1", 5), pkt(1, "c1", 1), pkt(2, "c1", 0), pkt(3, "c1", 0)],
)
r = run(doc)
st = [j["status"] for j in r["jobs"]]
check("s2 statuses", st == ["superseded", "applied", "applied", "applied"], st)
check("s2 job0 done", r["jobs"][0]["done"] == 5, r["jobs"][0])
check("s2 job1 done", r["jobs"][1]["done"] == 2, r["jobs"][1])
check("s2 job1 lane", r["jobs"][1]["lane"] == 1, r["jobs"][1])
check("s2 job0 lane", r["jobs"][0]["lane"] == 0, r["jobs"][0])
check("s2 votes", r["connections"][0]["votes"] == [3, 1], r["connections"][0])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scenario 3
# exact credit accounting with fractional tokens (rate_den = 3)
doc = dict(
    version=1,
    config=config(rate_num=1, rate_den=3, bucket_capacity=2, initial_tokens=2,
                  lanes=1, service=[1], window=1, idle_timeout=1000),
    model=model(),
    connections=[dict(id="c1", slot=0, label=0, split="dev")],
    packets=[pkt(0, "c1", 1), pkt(1, "c1", 1), pkt(2, "c1", 1), pkt(4, "c1", 1)],
)
r = run(doc)
# credit starts at 2*3 = 6
# t=0: refill min(6, 6+0)=6 ; send -> 6-3 = 3
# t=1: refill min(6, 3+1)=4 ; send -> 1
# t=2: refill min(6, 1+1)=2 ; tokens: 2 < 3 -> drop (credit stays 2)
# t=4: refill min(6, 2+2)=4 ; send -> 1
credits = [p["credit"] for p in r["packets"]]
check("s3 credits", credits == [3, 1, 2, 1], credits)
check("s3 decisions", [p["decision"] for p in r["packets"]] ==
      ["sent", "sent", "tokens", "sent"], [p["decision"] for p in r["packets"]])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scenario 4
# bucket saturation discards excess credit
doc = dict(
    version=1,
    config=config(rate_num=100, rate_den=1, bucket_capacity=2, initial_tokens=2,
                  window=1, lanes=1, service=[1]),
    model=model(),
    connections=[dict(id="c1", slot=0, label=0, split="dev")],
    packets=[pkt(0, "c1", 1), pkt(1, "c1", 1)],
)
r = run(doc)
credits = [p["credit"] for p in r["packets"]]
# t=0: 2 -> send -> 1 ; t=1: min(2, 1+100) = 2 -> send -> 1
check("s4 credits", credits == [1, 1], credits)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scenario 5
# window wraparound keeps the newest W rows
doc = dict(
    version=1,
    config=config(window=3, lanes=1, service=[1], idle_timeout=1000),
    model=model(),
    connections=[dict(id="c1", slot=0, label=0, split="dev")],
    packets=[pkt(i, "c1", i) for i in range(6)],
)
r = run(doc)
check("s5 warmup", [p["decision"] for p in r["packets"]] ==
      ["warmup", "warmup", "sent", "sent", "sent", "sent"],
      [p["decision"] for p in r["packets"]])
wins = [j["window"] for j in r["jobs"]]
check("s5 win0", wins[0] == [[0, 0], [1, 1], [2, 2]], wins[0])
check("s5 win1", wins[1] == [[1, 1], [2, 2], [3, 3]], wins[1])
check("s5 win3", wins[3] == [[3, 3], [4, 4], [5, 5]], wins[3])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scenario 6
# slot collision between two connections and reappearance
doc = dict(
    version=1,
    config=config(slots=1, window=1, lanes=1, service=[1], idle_timeout=1000),
    model=model(),
    connections=[dict(id="a", slot=0, label=0, split="dev"),
                 dict(id="b", slot=0, label=1, split="eval")],
    packets=[pkt(0, "a", 5), pkt(1, "b", 5), pkt(2, "a", 5), pkt(3, "b", 5)],
)
r = run(doc)
gens = [p["generation"] for p in r["packets"]]
check("s6 gens", gens == [1, 2, 3, 4], gens)
sts = [j["status"] for j in r["jobs"]]
check("s6 statuses", sts == ["stale", "stale", "stale", "applied"], sts)
check("s6 votes a", r["connections"][0]["votes"] == [0, 2], r["connections"][0])
check("s6 votes b", r["connections"][1]["votes"] == [0, 2], r["connections"][1])
check("s6 conf dev", r["reports"]["dev"]["confusion"] == [[1, 0], [0, 0]],
      r["reports"]["dev"])
check("s6 conf eval", r["reports"]["eval"]["confusion"] == [[0, 0], [0, 1]],
      r["reports"]["eval"])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scenario 7
# probability bins depend on both time since export and backlog count
doc = dict(
    version=1,
    config=config(window=1, lanes=1, service=[1], idle_timeout=1000,
                  time_edges=[0, 2], count_edges=[0, 1],
                  probability=[[65536, 65536], [0, 0]]),
    model=model(),
    connections=[dict(id="c1", slot=0, label=0, split="dev")],
    packets=[pkt(0, "c1", 1), pkt(1, "c1", 1), pkt(2, "c1", 1), pkt(3, "c1", 1)],
)
r = run(doc)
# after each export the anchor resets, so Ti is always 0 -> bin 0 -> allowed
check("s7 decisions", [p["decision"] for p in r["packets"]] ==
      ["sent"] * 4, [p["decision"] for p in r["packets"]])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scenario 8
# queue backpressure: pending_capacity reached
doc = dict(
    version=1,
    config=config(window=1, lanes=1, service=[100], pending_capacity=1,
                  idle_timeout=1000, rate_num=1000, rate_den=1,
                  bucket_capacity=100, initial_tokens=100),
    model=model(),
    connections=[dict(id="c1", slot=0, label=0, split="dev")],
    packets=[pkt(0, "c1", 1), pkt(1, "c1", 1), pkt(2, "c1", 1), pkt(200, "c1", 1)],
)
r = run(doc)
dec = [p["decision"] for p in r["packets"]]
check("s8 decisions", dec == ["sent", "queue", "queue", "sent"], dec)
check("s8 jobids", [p["job"] for p in r["packets"]] == [0, None, None, 1],
      [p["job"] for p in r["packets"]])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scenario 9
# equal timestamps keep array order
doc = dict(
    version=1,
    config=config(window=1, lanes=1, service=[1], idle_timeout=1000),
    model=model(),
    connections=[dict(id="c1", slot=0, label=0, split="dev")],
    packets=[pkt(5, "c1", 1), pkt(5, "c1", 2), pkt(5, "c1", 3)],
)
r = run(doc)
check("s9 gaps", [j["window"] for j in r["jobs"]] ==
      [[1, 0]], [j["window"] for j in r["jobs"]])

# --------------------------------------------------------------- scenario 10
# quantization clamping at 15 and gap quantisation
doc = dict(
    version=1,
    config=config(window=2, lanes=1, service=[1], idle_timeout=1000,
                  len_quantum=100, gap_quantum=10),
    model=model(),
    connections=[dict(id="c1", slot=0, label=0, split="dev")],
    packets=[pkt(0, "c1", 65535), pkt(25, "c1", 5)],
)
r = run(doc)
check("s10 win", r["jobs"][0]["window"] == [[15, 0], [0, 2]], r["jobs"][0]["window"])

print("scenario failures:", fails)
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
PYEOF
cd /app && python3 tmp/scenarios.py
